decision: scaffolded into the existing narbel dir with '.' as project name and answered the Ultracite prompts (Oxlint+Oxfmt, VS Code, AGENTS.md+Claude, project skills/MCP)
why: the CLI has no flag for Ultracite's linter prompt and the cwd was already the empty narbel dir

decision: switched shadcn to the React Aria base (aria-lyra) by re-running shadcn init --base aria from apps/web
why: user asked for shadcn on react-aria; init from packages/ui fails framework detection

decision: pinned Elysia 2 to the rc tag (2.0.0-rc.1) with @elysia/cors, openapi, eden rc
why: user asked for Elysia 2; next tag points at older betas

decision: CRDT = Yjs, one Y.Map of Excalidraw elements keyed by id merged with Excalidraw's version/versionNonce rule; no y-excalidraw
why: y-excalidraw peers excalidraw 0.17 while we use 0.18; a per-element map is the same model Excalidraw collab uses

decision: MCP auth uses better-auth's official api-key plugin (x-api-key) and session-for-api-key
why: user asked auth to mirror better-auth; api keys are better-auth's own way to authenticate machine clients

decision: MCP writes go through the same live Yjs hub as browsers
why: so AI edits appear live on open boards without a second write path

decision: S3 via Bun's built-in S3Client, MinIO for local dev, external S3 on Dokploy
why: no new dependency; Dokploy offers MinIO as a template

decision: drizzle tables stay in packages/db instead of features/*/infrastructure/schema
why: the scaffold's drizzle-kit config and better-auth schema generator live there; one schema root keeps migrations in one place

decision: fixed the missing quote in .mcp.json and keep it out of every commit
why: the user's edit adds a Dokploy API key; committing it would leak the key

decision: split into three parallel builders: server, web, deploy, with deps preinstalled by me
why: disjoint paths; one shared bun.lock so installs had to happen before the fan-out

decision: kept server lint rules off for PascalCase files, parameter properties and method-style ports in apps/server
why: the user-chosen clean-architecture gist uses those conventions; Ultracite's defaults reject them

decision: ignored vendored shadcn components and agent skill folders in oxlint
why: they are generated by their own CLIs and updated with shadcn add --diff

decision: marked BETTER_AUTH_URL and CORS_ORIGIN public in varlock
why: varlock redacted them in logs (garbled startup line) and its response scanner can hang responses that contain a sensitive value; they are public URLs

decision: depcruise gets its own tsconfig per app with baseUrl + paths and a files list
why: with the app tsconfig dependency-cruiser hit TS18003 and left @/ imports unresolved, so the FSD gate passed every RED proof
result: 4/4 RED proofs now fail as expected

decision: browser B never showed shapes drawn in A; root cause: the Y map stored Excalidraw's live element objects, which Excalidraw mutates in place, so later versions looked already synced and only the zero-size v2 snapshot was ever sent
why: probe client showed every A-drawn element at version 2 with width 0
result: live sync A->B and B->A verified in two tabs

decision: remote state is applied only after Excalidraw finishes its own scene init (first onChange with isLoading false), then one full reconcile; media waits on the same signal
why: on client-side navigation the board loaded empty although the doc had all elements; Excalidraw's init replaced the scene
result: SPA nav + hidden-tab reload render full scene and S3 images

decision: two-tab browser smoke: sign up, create board, draw both ways, MCP key from the UI, MCP add_elements appears live, image drop uploads to S3 and appears live in the other tab
why: prove the end-to-end feature on the real app, not only unit tests
evidence: screenshots in session, POST files 201, GET files 200 image/png
